_doc: Kalshi fee table (docs/specs/fee_model_spec.md, amendment 2026-10-23). Every value cites a page of the source bundle; its sha256 is checked on load. Built from the owner's screenshots of kalshi.com/fee-schedule and docs.kalshi.com Fee Rounding, 2026-10-23.

source.note: kalshi.com/fee-schedule as displayed 2026-10-23 ('No upcoming fee changes scheduled'); originals in docs/sources/kalshi-fees-2026-10-23/

default.cite: p.2 Standard fees, "Most markets: additional fees -, fee multiplier 1, $0.07 - $1.75 taker fees (100 contracts)" = 0.07 x 100 x p(1-p) at p = 0.01 and 0.50

settlement_fee.cite: No settlement fee appears on p.2-9 (only taker and maker fees are listed) or in the rounding mechanics on p.1; owner confirmed no settlement fee from the 2026-07-07 schedule (fee_model_spec.md, amendment 2026-10-22)

rounding.cite: p.1 Fee Rounding, Overview: "Direct member balances are aligned to $0.0001 (0.01c)"; trade fee "rounded up to the nearest $0.000001"

combo.cite: p.2 Standard fees, "Combos (excluding uncorrelated NFL): maker fees - 50% of taker, fee multiplier 1, $0.07 - $1.75 taker fees"; uncorrelated NFL combos fall under "Most markets: fee multiplier 1". Taker multiplier 1 for every combo.

KXEPLGAME.cite: p.4 Non-standard fees, "KXEPLGAME ... maker fees, multiplier 1, taker $0.07 - $1.75, maker $0.02 - $0.44 (100 contracts)"

KXMLBGAME.cite: p.9 Non-standard fees, "KXMLBGAME Professional Baseball Game, maker fees, 0.5 prelive, 1 live, taker $0.04 - $0.88, maker $0.01 - $0.22 (100 contracts)". PRE-GAME ONLY: the multiplier is 1 once live; valid here because every priced check is before the start (shadow.evaluate not_pre_game).
